metadata.title: LLM Evaluation Platform Comparative Benchmark
metadata.data_source_policy: Derived from docs/matrix-coverage.md live census, harness spikes (braintrust-spike.md, phoenix-spike.md), and e2e evaluation runs.

test_case_gen.name: Test Case Generation
test_case_gen.description: Evaluation of synthetic test suites, mutation coverage, executability, and green-on-correct invariant verification.

rca.name: Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
rca.description: Fault localization, onset detection within tolerance, causal attribution across component topologies, and abstention precision.

requirement_gen.name: Requirement Generation
requirement_gen.description: Verification of requirement obligation recall, acceptance criteria coverage, hallucination suppression, and semantic diversity.

dimensions.label: Test Case Gen
dimensions.description: Efficacy in synthetic test case synthesis, mutation verification, and executable assertion grading.

dimensions.label: Root Cause Analysis
dimensions.description: Depth of execution trace diagnostics, span drill-down, failure onset detection, and attribution.

dimensions.label: Requirement Gen
dimensions.description: Support for structured schema outputs, obligation recall scoring, and hallucination penalization.

dimensions.label: Trace Observability
dimensions.description: Span graph visualization, latency tracking, OpenTelemetry / OpenInference compliance.

dimensions.label: Air-Gap & Self-Host
dimensions.description: Ease of air-gapped private deployment, container portability, and local storage simplicity.

dimensions.label: SDK & Extensibility
dimensions.description: Clean modular seams, plugin support, custom scorer integration, and standard API bindings.

dimensions.label: TCO & Cost Efficiency
dimensions.description: Low runtime compute/memory overhead, open licensing, and minimal SaaS subscription exposure.

braintrust.telemetry_protocol: Native experiment.log API / OTLP span ingest

test_case_gen.rationale: Strong dataset versioning and prompt registry (F-026) enable repeatable test case suites, but lacks native mutation score evaluators.

rca.rationale: High-fidelity trace trees with execution latency, tokens, and metadata; excellent for diagnosing step-level errors.

requirement_gen.rationale: Prompt management playground simplifies iterating on extraction prompts, though requirement obligation scoring requires custom external harness logic.

observability_tracing.rationale: Mature UI with intuitive span drilldown, latency waterfalls, and user feedback tagging.

airgap_self_hosting.rationale: Fully self-hostable via Docker Compose; requires Postgres and ClickHouse containers for scalable production setups.

extensibility.rationale: Clean REST API and SDK client with well-defined dataset and sink registration seams in the harness.

tco_cost_efficiency.rationale: Open-source self-hosting eliminates software licensing fees; modest database hosting footprint.

test_case_gen.rationale: Datasets support Parquet and JSONL imports; leverages open formats for test fixture pipelines.

rca.rationale: Industry gold standard for RCA: OpenInference tracing reveals exact model inputs, system prompts, function calls, and error cascades with zero vendor lock-in.

requirement_gen.rationale: Native phoenix-evals pre-built judges assess classification correctness and hallucination detection via LLM-as-a-judge.

observability_tracing.rationale: Pure OpenTelemetry / OTLP native architecture; works seamlessly alongside any OTel collector.

airgap_self_hosting.rationale: Unrivaled ease of self-hosting: runs in a single Docker container or standalone local process with embedded SQLite, zero external dependencies required.

extensibility.rationale: Strict decoupling of tracing and score export seams; adheres cleanly to repo's NullClient pattern.

tco_cost_efficiency.rationale: Zero licensing cost for core self-hosted instance, ultra-low infrastructure footprint.

test_case_gen.rationale: Exceptional experiment iteration engine; built-in autoevals library (Levenshtein, ExactMatch, JSONDiff) provides instant offline validation.

rca.rationale: Experiment logging records full input/output/scores payloads per item, but deep multi-hop trace hierarchy is less prominent than Phoenix.

requirement_gen.rationale: Autoevals Factuality, ClosedQA, and JSON structure evaluators deliver state-of-the-art requirement validation and hallucination scoring.

observability_tracing.rationale: Solid span ingestion via OTLP, but primary product strength centers on evaluation datasets and experiments rather than APM tracing.

airgap_self_hosting.rationale: Cloud-first commercial architecture; requires external API connectivity (BRAINTRUST_API_KEY). Air-gapped self-hosting requires expensive enterprise engagement.

extensibility.rationale: autoevals is pure Python and standalone; SDK experiment.log seam is lean, though managed prompt integration is currently deferred.

tco_cost_efficiency.rationale: Commercial SaaS pricing with tier thresholds and per-seat / per-evaluation charges adds ongoing operational expense.
